items: Remove and destroy infected plant debris after harvest.
Clean field tools and equipment to reduce disease spread.
Avoid moving infected plant material between fields.
Use proper spacing to improve airflow and reduce humidity inside the canopy.
Avoid excessive nitrogen that can increase lush growth and susceptibility.
Manage irrigation timing to reduce prolonged leaf wetness.
Scout fields regularly during weather conditions favorable for disease.
Record symptom progression to guide timely interventions.
Inspect lower leaves and stem bases early in disease development.
